Learn moreSign in Comments 8 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Why the word "and" DISAPPEARS in fast spoken English! 511Likes20,327Views2025Apr 1 Did you know "and" often disappears in fast English? 🤯🎧 Ever hear a native speaker say “red, white, and blue” and wonder why it sounds more like “red, white ‘n blue”? That’s because in fast speech, "and" shrinks to just “n”! Here are more examples: 👇 ✅ Rock n roll (not “rock AND roll”) 🎸 ✅ Fish n chips (not “fish AND chips”) 🍟 ✅ Black n white (not “black AND white”) 🎬 We don’t even realize we’re doing it—it just flows naturally! Try saying them out loud!
